subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PLAY’ Is coded as RICV and ‘TREE’ Is coded as VOGB. How will ‘BOOK’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First two letters → (2) and (3) are added respectively to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Last two letters → (2) and (3) are subtracted respectively from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• ‘PLAY’ Is coded as RICV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83a6f2c1b482d91d797e8f187260061f1ef5dbf33f58fe61fe447b4cf6f63400.png] 

And,

 
• ‘TREE’ Is coded as VOGB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8264914abd412a884fd362922739ad611c32de4f18890da4ead774e1fa49f400.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘BOOK’ will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/261062268c8b1c630a97c0cca68d60d641dd2ef0919ff1419232b24946f77d00.png] 

​Hence, "**DLQH**" is the correct answer.
